question: The phrase** 'A white elephant**’ refers to:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Costly burden**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"A white elephant"** refers to something that is expensive to maintain and of little practical value; it is a metaphor for a costly burden. (महंगा बोझ)

 
 
• **Example:** The new stadium has become a white elephant for the city due to its high maintenance costs and lack of use.
 
 
 
• **White Elephant** in English refers to an item that may seem valuable but becomes a burden because of its maintenance cost or impracticality. (महंगा और अनुपयोगी उपहार या वस्तु)
 
 
• **Example:** The gifted luxury car turned into a white elephant for him as he couldn't afford its upkeep.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is: **Costly burden**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Costly burden**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lucky charm** (सौभाग्य का प्रतीक): An object believed to bring good luck.

 
 
• **Example:** She always carries her lucky charm bracelet during exams.
 
 
 
• **Valuable item** (मूल्यवान वस्तु): Something that has great value or importance.
 
 
• **Example:** This antique vase is a valuable item passed down through generations in our family.
 
 
 
• **Rare animal** (दुर्लभ पशु): An animal that is uncommon or endangered.
 
 
• **Example:** The snow leopard is considered a rare animal due to its dwindling population.
